task.description: Scope-creep/fabricated-data hard gate on ISS-0532's health-check fix.

result.note: Scope clean via git show --stat: only contract-gaps.md, health.ts, HealthDashboardPage.tsx, sh05-06.shell.e2e.spec.ts, and 4 new test files changed; router.ex and all backend files confirmed untouched (empty diff on that path). No fabricated data: HealthDashboardPage.tsx:70-87 renders an honest readiness-not-available block, no synthesized database/scheduler status objects anywhere, confirmed by grep and by TC-ISS0532-12 explicitly asserting their absence. healthReady() (health.ts:30-37) correctly calls GET /health, returns true/false, never throws; useApiConnectivity.ts has zero diff, contract preserved exactly. Removed dead code (getReadinessSnapshot/toSnapshotFromOk/toSnapshotFromDegraded/AdminHealthSnapshot/Readiness*) confirmed genuinely dead via grep, zero remaining references. healthApi.get (GET /api/v1/health) confirmed still present and explicitly commented as intentionally-left dead code, not swept into cleanup. Test quality confirmed genuine: all 4 new/updated test files would fail against pre-fix code and pass against the fix -- real regression coverage. contract-gaps.md edit confirmed a single-line in-place annotation, not a rewrite, surrounding content and S6/NOT-YET-IMPLEMENTED classification preserved. Real runs quoted: npm run check (type-check/lint/test/guards) in web/ -- tsc -b clean, eslint clean, vitest run 36 files/199 tests passed including all 4 new files, guards 48 tests passed including a full production vite build. One non-blocking incidental note: sh05-06.shell.e2e.spec.ts's /**/health route stub glob would also match /api/v1/health if that dead code is ever revived -- moot today, flagged for awareness only.
